About Maram

A Century of Legacy,
Built on Integrity

In the global timber trade, time is the ultimate measure of quality and reliability. Maram Trading Company Pvt Ltd is the modern manifestation of a profound, four-generation legacy that spans nearly a century. Today, our company stands as a unique bridge between eras, managed by the enduring wisdom of our great-grandfather and driven by the strategic innovation of the fourth generation. This lineage ensures that every cubic meter of wood we trade carries with it a century of reputation, expertise, and an ancestral commitment to integrity.

To meet the rigorous demands of India's industrial and architectural sectors, we have established an elite procurement network spanning four continents. Our reach is truly global, sourcing premium, sustainable timber from the high-durability reserves of Latin America, the structural hardwoods of Africa, and the gold-standard plantations of Malaysia and South East Asia. This vast geographical footprint allows us to provide a diversified portfolio of species, ensuring our clients have access to the specific grain and density required for large-scale projects.
